summary_en: 7,290,251 shares tendered (42.0% of shares outstanding ex-treasury). Tender price ¥1,207/share (minimum acceptance threshold 4,165,800 shares met). Tender period 22 June–3 August 2026. Settlement from 10 August 2026. Terra Co. (100% owned by Luna Capital) to become parent and largest shareholder; Tommy Corporation to cease being largest shareholder.
summary_jp: 公開買付応募数7,290,251株（発行済株式の42.0%）。買付価格1,207円/株。下限4,165,800株以上の応募要件満たす。2026年6月22日～8月3日実施、8月10日決済開始。テラ株式会社が親会社・筆頭主要株主に就任。

summary_en: Tender offer price raised to ¥1,260/share from ¥1,220/share. Terra acquiring Satudora Holdings with goal of taking company private. Commitment pledges received from four shareholders totalling 3,433,300 shares (24.91% of S/O) to tender at revised price. Offer commenced 22 June 2026.
summary_jp: 公開買付価格を1,220円から1,260円に引き上げ。テラがサツドラホールディングスを買収し非公開化を目指す。4名の株主から計3,433,300株（発行済株式の24.91%）の応募誓約獲得。2026年6月22日開始。
